div.div:
NON-TECHNICAL: Like a restaurant testing a new recipe on a few tables first, watching customer reactions, then slowly rolling it out if everyone loves it!
TECHNICAL: Canary deployment with automated monitoring. Track key metrics (latency, reward, errors). Define thresholds for auto-rollback. Use A/B testing for statistical validation.
